facts: Parties: Fenwick Retail Group plc (Buyer), Whitlock Retail Group plc (Seller); the Company is Kestrel Holdings Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 22 February 2026; Closing is scheduled for 22 April 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 8.3 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 12% of the Purchase Price, being $10,500,000. The Purchase Price is $70,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $700,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Merrion Energy plc.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,650,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $69,300,000.
